description: Explore ProjectWise workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

ProjectWise

ProjectWise manages infrastructure project information, document control and multidisciplinary delivery.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Find a controlled document set

Begin with the controlled identifier, current revision and relationship context. In the intended ProjectWise preview, find a controlled document set; the visible result is the matching record, document or model tree with ownership visible. Review source system, revision, permissions and record identity before accepting or exporting it.

Coordinate a design package

Use the proposed change, exchange or coordination package. In the intended ProjectWise preview, coordinate a design package; the visible result is a versioned change set with affected objects and approvals exposed. Review scope, dependencies, recipients and comparison accuracy before accepting or exporting it.

Issue a transmittal

Start from the release, transmittal or review criteria. In the intended ProjectWise preview, issue a transmittal; the visible result is a traceable status view with history and outstanding decisions. Review approvers, effective revision, audit trail and delivery state before accepting or exporting it.
